rules: An orphan has no reasonable inbound route from a canonical hub, parent, workflow, search result or contextual relationship.
A dead end has no logical next step after the page's primary task, even if the page itself is discoverable.
Global navigation and Page Help are recovery mechanisms, not substitutes for a useful task-specific continuation.
Do not add generic related-link blocks to every page; terminal and policy surfaces can remain terminal when that matches the user task.
